body:
STAGE 1b DOWNSTREAM EXACT-PATH PROPOSAL ONLY. No reservation and no edit until the contract lands, per the accepted sequencing. I am announcing the README surface now because AGENTS requires that before editing it.

PROPOSED PATHS, all inside the already-approved JVM-only provider-parser project:
- provider-parser/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/subprocess.scala: a bounded persistent JSON-lines ParserTransport using only the JDK, explicit lifecycle via AutoCloseable, synchronized exchange, timeout kill and restart, exact one-response framing, bounded stdout, continuously drained stderr with count plus checksum, and no raw stderr in failures.
- provider-parser/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/transitionamr.scala: validated command and local-artifact preflight that can return the frozen runtime Unavailable reasons before any process call. No download and no environment discovery that silently changes the receipt.
- provider-parser/src/main/resources/storymodel4s/provider/parser/transition_amr_worker.py: the pinned-source wrapper. Load once; call parse_sentences on singleton atlas-token vectors; obtain actual parser machine tokens and normalized model input rather than copying the request; call machine.get_amr so ID remapping and structured alignments move together; render only ExplicitIndexListV1 plus the occurrence sidecar; catch materialization per item.
- provider-parser/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/SubprocessSuite.scala and TransitionAmrSuite.scala, plus provider-parser/src/test/resources/storymodel4s/provider/parser/fake_transition_worker.py.
- provider-parser/README.md: runtime and authority boundary, after this announcement.

PUBLIC VOCABULARY REQUIRING EXPLICIT OK: SubprocessParserTransport, ParserProcessConfig, and TransitionAmrRuntimePreflight, or chief-selected names. No new module, sbt dependency, or build.sbt edit.

COURTS BEFORE A REAL MODEL: fake worker proves model-loaded-once, actual observed-input mismatch, parser-state token rewrite, A/B/C/D sidecar behavior, good A beside materialization-bad B in both orders, timeout then sibling restart, nonzero exit, malformed or extra stdout, output-size cap, stderr checksum without raw leakage, deterministic request bytes, and close leaves no owned worker alive. Mutations copy request tokens, omit sidecar equality, or skip timeout destruction and must fail named controls.

REAL-RUNTIME GATE REMAINS SEPARATE. Current evidence is Python 3.14 host incompatibility; pinned parser and checkpoint plus local BART are about 4.97 GB compressed before extraction, and current free disk was about 12 GB. I will not download or execute external Torch or pickle-like model bytes without user authority and a safe resource plan. The adapter can lawfully land with ArtifactMissing, PlatformIncompatible, or ResourceBudgetInsufficient evidence; it cannot claim WOG coverage until an exact pinned runtime executes. Please approve or amend the names and paths now; I will still wait for the contract landing before mote preflight or begin.
